title: Galactic Snacks
description: Adds a wide variety of your favorite Star Wars snacks!
body:
![Galactic Snacks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/763beff4f26afc74135a8fac7652cc4f4d33bc95.png)
Enjoy the wonderful world of Star Wars cuisine! Craft up some ration packets or fry up some porgsicles in this exciting new mod! Perfect for Star Wars lovers!
Adds:
- Porgsicles
- Nuna Drumsticks
- Bantha Steaks
- Unlimited POWAHH Energy Bars
- Jawa Juice
- Sarlacc Jerky
- Ration packs
- Blue Milk
- Green Milk
- Bantha Burger
